title: 【うんちく】ヒトデは、タコや虫より「ヒトの親せき」 #Shorts
description:
動物の木は早いうちに大きく2つに分かれました。片方にタコ・虫・貝、もう片方にヒトデ・ウニ・ナマコと、魚、そしてヒト。決め手は、赤ちゃんのときに体にできる最初の穴が、口ではなくおしりになること。

アプリ「いのちの系統樹」（名前のついた約225万種の木）に関係する話です。

アプリ: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/tree-of-life/

しし屋 まなびラボ（ほかのアプリ）: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

出どころ: UCMP (University of California Museum of Paleontology) Introduction to the Deuterostomia。多くの研究での分け方で、ちがう結果の解析もあります。

声: VOICEVOX:冥鳴ひまり

en.title: Did you know? Starfish are closer relatives of humans than octopuses #Shorts
en.description:
The animal tree split in two early on. One side: octopuses, insects, snails. The other: starfish, sea urchins, sea cucumbers, fish, and us. The clue is in the embryo: the first opening becomes the anus, not the mouth. Turn on English subtitles (CC).

Related to the app "Tree of Life" (about 2.25 million named species).

App (switch to English with the EN button): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/tree-of-life/

Shishiya Manabi Lab (more apps): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/?lang=en

Sources: UCMP (University of California Museum of Paleontology), Introduction to the Deuterostomia. This is the grouping in most studies; some analyses differ.
